arabic: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نُبَاحَ الْكِلَابِ وَنَهِيقَ الْحَمِيرِ بِاللَّيْلِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللهِ فَإِنَّهُنَّ يَرَيْنَ مَا لَا تَرَوْنَ.
transliteration: Ithaa sami'tum nubaahal-kilaabi wa naheeqal-hameeri billayli fata'awwathoo billaahi, fa-innahunna yarayna maa laa tarawn.
translation: When you hear the barking of dogs and the braying of donkeys at night, seek refuge in Allah, for they see what you do not see.
